coaching.headline: Objective damage finished 6,752 to 89,834 — Sparrow and Sevarog ate the entire map while our one won fight bought nothing.
coaching.team: The reads leaned our way — carry, offlane and jungle all favored — and the map still ran off: they cashed six of their seven won fights, our single win at 12.5 converted to nothing, and towers finished 2-10. Itemization compounded it: Sevarog healed 31280 through our fights, and the film flags two of us with no magic resist into their three-magical comp. The fights themselves kept starting short-handed — at 16.3, 18.2 and 23.5 a winning lane sat out while a 0-2 or 0-3 went down across the map.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 0-2 at their outer tower at 23.5 priced out Orb Prime and both inner towers inside ninety seconds — from there every death rolled straight into the inhibitors and the 29.2 core.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Murdock held the favored read and won the only fight we won — the 2-0 at our outer tower at 12.5 — but finished 1/7, and the deaths at 14.3, 16.4, 19.7 and 26.8 each directly preceded a lost Fangtooth, tower or Primal Fangtooth. The macro also flags him ahead-and-absent at 18.2 and 23.5; Murdock's global ult exists precisely so a winning carry can be present in those fights without leaving lane.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Kallari got the picks the kit is built for — Gideon at 9.1 and 20 — but 3/7/0 with zero assists says the rest was solo play: caught by Sevarog at 3.9 and 10, with no magic resist into a three-magical comp. A stealth assassin dying alone to the scaling tank twice by minute 10 is feeding exactly the Soul stacks that made Sevarog finish 6/1.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's mid was read 'theirs all game' into Gideon and the film treats him as pinned, not throwing — the early short-handed losses happened while he was stuck in a losing lane. The expensive window was 23.5 to 26.4: two deaths near their towers that the file prices at Orb Prime, both inner towers, Primal Fangtooth and the inhibitors.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
ourKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
ourKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

loadout.text: Gain 5% (+1% per Level) increased Maximum Health, and bonus size equal to 0.5% of your Maximum Health.
loadout.plain: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness that stacks with the health Sevarog's souls already give him.

loadout.name: Regenerative Tissue
loadout.text: After 8s without taking Hero damage, regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health per second at Levels 1/6/11/16.
loadout.plain: Heal a share of max health after a few seconds away from hero damage. Big max health from souls makes each tick worth more between fights.

loadout.name: Cannibalism
loadout.text: Takedowns permanently increase your Maximum Health by 25.
loadout.plain: Each takedown adds permanent max health. Plain tankiness on top of your soul stacks.

loadout.name: Razorback
loadout.text: Echidna:  Gain 20% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s. Reflect 15% of Pre-Mitigated Damage received from Heroes as Damage.
loadout.plain: Short burst of armor plus reflected damage back at heroes hitting you. Use it when the enemy turns to focus you after Subjugate.

lead.text: 1,079 healing a minute, more than 98% of Sevarog jungle players this patch. It came from the Eternal setup (Krix, Regenerative Tissue, Cannibalism) plus Grim Harvest, Razorback, Fist Of Razuul.

copy.text: Krix (Regenerative Tissue + Cannibalism): 46.5% in 598 Sevarog jungle games, below the hero's 47.7%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
